messages:
mira: spotted discrepancy between invoice-preview and final ledger for route-splitter customers. seems tied to quota-muxing when routing policy falls back.

tony: can you show the delta?

mira: preview undercounts per-route charges by ~2.7% for customers using `route-splitter-v2` on high concurrency. ledger corrects after batch enrichment.

lee: root cause hypothesis?

mira: route-splitter emits provisional events without tenant_fingerprint when quota manager defers resolution; enrichment adds tenant later. preview runs before enrichment.

tony: so preview is reading early materialized events. maybe reorder preview pipeline to wait for enrichment?

ops-bot: alert: invoice_preview.delta_by_route > 1% (window 3h)

lee: reordering adds latency to preview snapshot. product will push back. alternative: mark provisional events with "pending" flag and exclude them from preview until enriched.

mira: prefer flagging. less chance of adding latency. also expose a "provisional coverage" stat in the console.

tony: agree. impl plan: 1) change route-splitter to attach provisional=true on emitted pre-enrich events; 2) preview pipeline ignores provisional unless forced; 3) console shows provisional-percent metric and samples.

mira: will sketch migration: preview consumer needs to read modified schema and ignore those events. backward compat: if provisional field absent treat as final.

billing-bot: snapshot: {window: "3h", pct_delta: 2.73, affected_customers: 5}

lee: deployment plan? we need canary rollout for splitter and preview consumer changes simultaneously to avoid gaps. coordinated deploy via canary tag.

deploy-bot: scheduling coordinated canary: splitter v2.3.1-canary + preview-consumer v0.9.5-canary

tony: add telemetry: per-route provisional-rate and the time-to-enrich histogram. that will help ops decide thresholds and whether to backfill.

mira: backfill if finance requests credits: re-run enrichment step on raw events and re-aggregate. idempotency: use event_id dedupe and ledger-check.

lee: UX ask: in Billing -> Invoice Preview show "provisional coverage" and tooltips explaining why preview may differ. include a link to run a live query (kafka tail).

mira: small frontend piece. we can ship banner and a link to examples in 1 day. metric pipeline ~2 dev days.

tony: also add an admin toggle to include provisional events in preview for debugging/testing. behind feature-flag.

mira: thanks, filing RFC and will coordinate canary window.
